decisions.reason: As the flagship organic salami line that builds directly on the firm's curing and seasoning knowledge, it is highly likely to be kept.
It remains a salami-based snack with recent new launches, so the firm can assimilate and improve it using existing expertise.
Organic boiled pork sausage fits the firm's traditional sausage-making capabilities and organic expansion, so it is kept.

Because organic thinly sliced chicken breast is outside the firm's core curing and sausage expertise and its earlier poultry snack already disappeared, absorptive capacity theory suggests the firm will likely drop it.
Herb-coated salami leverages the firm's core salami and seasoning expertise, so it is kept.
